analysis.summary: Removal of CloudFront Function eliminates URL rewriting logic for static files and .well-known paths, potentially causing 404 errors

bugs.title: CloudFront Function removal breaks static file routing
bugs.description: The CloudFront Function `cfFunction` that handled URL rewriting (appending .html extensions, resolving / to index.html, and handling .well-known paths) was completely removed along with its associations. Requests to paths like `/about` will no longer resolve to `/about.html`, and directory roots like `/folder/` will not resolve to `/folder/index.html`. Additionally, `.well-known` paths lose explicit passthrough handling.
bugs.risk: Will cause 404 errors for extensionless URLs and directory indexes if the static site relies on this rewriting logic. May break SSL certificate validation if `.well-known` paths are served from S3 and require special handling.

notBugs.reason: The change from `/bff/*` to `${baseUrl}/bff/*` in both BffApi.ts route definitions and the removal of pathRewrite in webpack config appear to be coordinated changes. The API routes and proxy configuration now use consistent full paths including the base URL prefix.

While the Routes type includes functionName and route definitions provide it, enrichRoutes computes its own functionName. This is redundant but not a bug unless specific function names are required by external dependencies (no evidence in diff).
Cannot confirm if featureAppName is missing from AppConfig return value without seeing the AppConfig file content.
